parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The ingest domain. Multi-domain queries are not supported.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query logs.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: [1, 9223372036854775807].

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Valid values: \[1, 1000\]. Default value: 300.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query logs.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
